title: CSS + AppContextFooter + useAppShellViewModel cleanup batch
description: Fix 4 issues across 3 files: (1) add --composer-focus-ring dark mode override to globals.css; (2) fix token block blank line formatting in globals.css; (3) remove focus-visible classes from non-interactive AppContextFooter div; (4) rename onOpenKnowledgePanel → onToggleKnowledgePanel in useAppShellViewModel.ts.
action: Three-file batch: (A) src/styles/globals.css — in the .dark block, after '--focus-outline-soft: rgba(196, 181, 253, 0.24);', add '--composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5); /* violet-400 at 50% for dark mode */'. Also add a blank line before the '/* Composer toolbar sizing tokens */' comment block in :root. (B) src/components/AppContextFooter.tsx — on the outer div (line 13), remove the three classes: 'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50'. (C) src/hooks/useAppShellViewModel.ts — rename 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel' (all occurrences in this file, typically just the property key in chatAreaProps).

files.change: Add --composer-focus-ring dark override; add blank line before composer token section
Remove focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 from div

implementation: Read src/styles/globals.css. In the .dark block, find the line '--focus-outline-soft: rgba(196, 181, 253, 0.24);'. Insert on the next line: '  --composer-focus-ring: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5); /* violet-400 at 50% for dark mode */'

In src/styles/globals.css :root block, find the comment '/* Composer toolbar sizing tokens */'. Ensure there is a blank line immediately before this comment (between the last sidebar token line and this comment).

Read src/components/AppContextFooter.tsx. On the outer div at line ~13, the className is: 'shell-text-compact px-4 py-1 text-gray-400 dark:text-dark-text-secondary border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50'. Remove the three focus-visible classes, leaving: 'shell-text-compact px-4 py-1 text-gray-400 dark:text-dark-text-secondary border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border'

Read src/hooks/useAppShellViewModel.ts. Find the chatAreaProps object where 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' is defined as a key. Rename it to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel'. This is likely one occurrence: 'onToggleKnowledgePanel: () => panelOrchestration.toggleRightPanel(\'knowledge\')'
Run pnpm test to verify no regressions.

convergence.verification: grep 'composer-focus-ring' src/styles/globals.css; grep 'focus-visible' src/components/AppContextFooter.tsx (expect no output); grep 'onToggleKnowledgePanel' src/hooks/useAppShellViewModel.ts

rationale.chosen_approach: Batch all cross-file cleanup into one task since none of the 3 files overlap with Wave 1 TASK-001 or TASK-002.
decision_factors: All changes are tiny (<5 lines each)
rationale.tradeoffs: None — pure cleanup with no behavior change.
